house.description: Improved medical care in licensed correctional facilities provided.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Public Safety Finance and Policy
House rule 4.20, interim disposition of bills, returned to Public Safety Finance and Policy

latest_action.text: House rule 4.20, interim disposition of bills, returned to Public Safety Finance and Policy

additions: This act shall be known as "Larry R. Hill Medical Reform Act."
, including a process for determining on intake whether a Jarvis Order is in place and ensuring it will be followed during the confinement or incarceration

Correctional facilities, as defined in subdivision 1, shall provide to incarcerated individuals the same medications prescribed to those individuals prior to their incarceration or confinement unless a licensed health care professional, as defined in chapter 147 or 148, determines the medication is no longer needed because the condition treated by the medication has resolved; the incarcerated individual no longer wishes to take the medication; or a more effective medication is prescribed to treat the condition and is acceptable to the incarcerated individual.
